title: Equity Brief — 17 Sep 2026
intro: Markets operate in transitional regime with VIX at 15.92 as US futures drift lower while European indices show synchronized strength in early trading. Asia-Pacific mixed with China weakness offsetting Japanese resilience, setting up defensive rotation into European value ahead of US open.

🇪🇺 EUROPE

FTSE 100 10,781 up 0.87% outperforming on defensive positioning with healthcare and consumer staples leading gainers.
CAC 40 8,175 up 0.43% holding above 8,150 as LVMH consolidates but industrial names provide support.
💻 TECH FOCUS
Meta 673.31 +0.46% week +4.49% — AI monetization narrative driving outperformance as advertising metrics improve and Llama adoption accelerates.
Microsoft 490.30 -1.37% — Azure growth concerns resurface on competitive pressure; 485 support critical for maintaining uptrend structure.

sections.heading: 🎯 TRADE IDEAS
sections.content:
LONG: FTSE 100 10,781 — defensive rotation favors UK exposure with dividend yields attractive — entry 10,750-10,780 — SL 10,650 — TP 10,950
LONG: Meta 673.31 — momentum and AI leadership intact — entry 670-675 — SL 655 — TP 710
SHORT/AVOID: Amazon 245.96 -2.35% week — retail margin pressure and cloud competition create downside risk toward 235 support.
